modules.module_title: Select and prepare the site for cotton cultivation

pcs.pc_description: check the site has conducive climatic conditions for cotton cultivation and is free from limiting factors such as flooding, drought, extreme heat and cold
coordinate with an authorised lab for soil testing to determine if the soil is suitable for cotton cultivation
ensure the site is accessible and has availability of quality water, labour and other inputs
identify the risks associated with cotton cultivation at the site and take appropriate preventive measures
carry out primary and secondary tilling using the appropriate farm machineries to achieve the recommended tilth for sowing cotton seeds
level the field using the appropriate machinery
create ridges and furrows maintaining the recommended space
create drainage channels for effective drainage of water
install an appropriate irrigation or fertigation system and create water channels for efficient irrigation

modules.module_title: Procure and prepare the cotton seeds for planting

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate variety of cotton to be cultivated according to the climate, soil conditions, time of planting, cultivation duration, marketability, etc.
select an approved vendor based on the quality and price of cotton seeds and procure cotton seeds in the required quantity

ensure the cotton seeds meet the applicable quality standards, such as staple length, ginning outturn, spun specifications, disease and pest tolerance, fiber properties, tract suitability, and expected yield
treat the seeds with the recommended pesticides and fungicides using them in the recommended dose
store the treated seeds at the recommended temperature and humidity, ensuring hygienic conditions in the storage area
select an appropriate method for sowing cotton seeds such as broadcasting or mechanised sowing
sow the cotton seeds at the recommended seed rate using the relevant tools/ implements, maintaining the recommended planting density to achieve healthy growth of plants
sow extra seeds to fill the infillings

modules.module_title: Follow preventive measures to control pests and disease

pcs.pc_description: use pest and disease-resistant varieties of cotton
carry out crop rotation with suitable crops
follow the recommended practices to restrict the entry of pathogens into the field through planting material, irrigation water, workers, tools and equipment, and vectors such as whitefly
identify and remove the diseased crop to prevent the spread of pest and disease to healthy crop
use the recommended combination of biological, mechanical and chemical control methods for effective pest and disease prevention
use the recommended parasitoids trichogramma spp. and telenomus spp., microplitis demolitor and tachinid flies, banded caterpillar parasite, etc.

employ environmentally friendly pest management strategies to reduce pesticide use and protect beneficial insects

modules.module_title: Identify the pests and disease in the cotton crop

conduct regular field visits to identify major cotton crop diseases such as wilt, root rot, boll rot, leaf blight, leaf spot, leaf curl virus, yellow mosaic virus, bacterial blight, etc.
determine the stage of pest and disease incidence along with the extent of damage and economic threshold levels (ETL) of the pests
co-ordinate with the agricultural extension service agents and diagnostic clinics to determine the causal organism for the disease and its treatment
